rows.grounds: first member of compound ācārya-caraṇa-dvaṃdvaṃ denoting the teacher whose feet are revered
second member of compound ācārya-caraṇa-dvaṃdvaṃ, the feet as object of salutation
head of compound ācārya-caraṇa-dvaṃdvaṃ, indicating the pair of feet
adverbial form describing full prostration performed with eight parts of the body
indeclinable comparison indicating prostration flat like a stick
optative verbal form expressing the act of reverential salutation
